name: The Prisoner
source:
The Prisoner is a horror story in which you awake within a prison and are forced to play a game of trust and betrayal with another inmate in order to decide who stays and who leaves.

[From [url=https://jaykozatt.itch.io/the-prisoner]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《囚徒》是一个恐怖故事，你在监狱中醒来，被迫与另一名囚犯玩信任与背叛的游戏，以决定谁留下、谁离开。

[来自[url=https://jaykozatt.itch.io/the-prisoner]Itch.io[/url]]
